author: Clijmart
body:
Hey Avicus players!

I've been playing DTM a lot this week and loved everything. Well, almost everything...
Lots of people may have noticed, but atleast I have:
More good players on avicus -> extremely long rounds...
You might say: 'I love long rounds, they're exciting!' and I can agree with that in some way, but in MY opinion a single round/map should not take over an hour...
Not saying they should add any stuff that suddenly stops the thing, but something to make rounds not take hours upon hours would be nice.

Yeah, this idea is based on something Overcast has done in one of their gamemodes, but is that a problem? Is it bad that servers take good ideas from others, improve them, and make all server better? No, I don't think so...

The idea:
When a match takes too long, all monuments get downgraded. This means they turn into a block which mines quicker.
This way it gets easier to break for both teams.
The downgrading could be like:
  • Obsidian, at the start of the game
  • Emerald block, after 30 minutes
  • End stone, after 45 minutes
  • Packed ice, after 60 minutes
Ofcourse this could be different, it's just an idea!

Please guys, don't tell me not to copy Overcast and stuff... You gotta admit it could be awesome on Avicus and make the gameplay even better!

Thanks a lot for reading, I'm out :P
- Clijmart

replies.body:
No way, that ruins the challenge of a heavily defended monument. Alongside that, if it comes to a point where you are fed up and it seems like the map is a stalemate, just leave and go play another map. :P

And think about the maps that have enchants like Clay Wars for example. Eff 3 Pic on an Emerald would ony talk up to 2 seconds. I appreciate the idea though, I'm sure others will too

replies.author: vladthegreat100
replies.body:
When it comes to breaking a monument, breaking obsidian is a factor, but what you are saying is that it takes longer due to defending. The real reason why it takes so long is because no one can actually get to the monument due to the defenders. Monument breaking tbh is a really small factor.
And I'm not sure if its still a thing but after an hour of gameplay you can contact a mapdev to skip that map. Not 100% sure if its still a thing but it was a few months ago.
But I do like this idea even though its pretty small, it will give players who do get to the monument a better chance.
